item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded: So I had my suspicions when I saw this was about an Author Avatar, but you managed to balance the over the top aspects with enough human moments to make it believable. I also like how each part flows into the next. I was just confused and a bit underwhelmed by the descriptions in the part where Cimmerian kills the gods. There is no detail about their appearances, powers or anything for me to build a picture from. Other than that, quite a cinematic and surprisingly heartwarming little story that fits with the tone of the Ressurrection Tales. Have a +1.

item.content:encoded:
So Perelka_L made some fan art of Cimmerian a week or so back and it inspired me to make a tale which inspired Perelka to do a new piece of art for the tale and this is what we got.

Good times. Loosely in the Resurrection Canon, I suppose.

Lots of folk looked this over and provided me with valuable feedback, but special thanks to Hippo for the line by line that I think really helped improve this over the original piece I wrote.
